gloss: to wither; to die (plants); to dry up

definitions.explanation: When plants, flowers, or trees lose vitality and die.

definitions.gloss: to dry up; to run dry
definitions.explanation: When a water source, well, or stream dries up.
Figuratively, when someone's style or manner becomes refined through age and experience.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}をやらなかったので、{花|はな}が{枯|か}れてしまった。
examples.english: The flowers withered because I didn't water them.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}って{声|こえ}が{枯|か}れてきた。
examples.english: His voice has become hoarse with age.
The tree in the garden died.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}さで{芝生|しばふ}が{枯|か}れた。
examples.english: The lawn died from the heat.

examples.japanese: {観葉植物|かんようしょくぶつ}が{枯|か}れそうだ。
examples.english: The houseplant is about to die.

examples.japanese: {日照|ひで}りで{井戸|いど}が{枯|か}れた。
examples.english: The well dried up due to the drought.

examples.japanese: {泉|いずみ}が{枯|か}れてしまった。
{涙|なみだ}が{枯|か}れるまで{泣|な}いた。
examples.english: I cried until my tears ran dry.

examples.japanese: {アイデア|あいであ}が{枯|か}れた。
{才能|さいのう}が{枯|か}れることはない。
{枯|か}れた{味|あじ}わいがある。
examples.english: There's a refined, mature taste to it.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{演技|えんぎ}は{枯|か}れた{魅力|みりょく}がある。
examples.english: His acting has a mature charm.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}って{枯|か}れた{雰囲気|ふんいき}になった。
examples.english: With age, he developed a mellow demeanor.

examples.japanese: {枯|か}れた{芸風|げいふう}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: His refined artistic style is popular.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}を{経|へ}て、{枯|か}れた{文体|ぶんたい}が{身|み}についた。
examples.english: After many years of experience, he developed a mature writing style.

notes:
{枯|か}れる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive pair is {枯|か}らす (to let wither, to let dry up).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{枯|か}れている indicates a resulting state of being withered or dried up.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {花|はな}/{草|くさ}が{枯|か}れる - flowers/grass withers
- {木|き}が{枯|か}れる - a tree dies
- {井戸|いど}/{川|かわ}が{枯|か}れる - well/river dries up
- {声|こえ}が{枯|か}れる - voice becomes hoarse
- {枯|か}れ{葉|は} - dead/fallen leaves

RELATED WORDS:
- {萎|しお}れる - to wilt (temporary, often recoverable)
- {枯|か}れる is more permanent than {萎|しお}れる
